text:
karen-support: customer reports repeated 502s for hosted inference after yesterday's auth heartbeat change. high p50/p95 for generation calls, a few customers complaining about timeouts. holding their support call now :rotating_light:

sam-oncall: on it — can you paste a sample trace id / curl we can use to repro? also which region + tenant id?

karen-support: sent sample in DM: trace=tx-0a1b2c3d user-tenant=acme-42 region=eu1. here is the curl we got from them:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Tenant-ID: acme-42" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-v1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
response: HTTP/2 502, body empty, edge returned upstream reset.

jeff-infra: thanks. quick check: Envoy logs show upstream RST_STREAM 0x1234 at ~12:01:22 across multiple frontdoors. I'm seeing h2 stream window errors and lots of connection-level GOAWAYs from the auth-proxy pool.

maria-sre: pattern: spikes align with auth-heartbeat config flip at 11:58 (rolled to 30s heartbeat from 5s). hypothesis: auth-proxy idle/keepalive mismatch with frontdoor, causing conn reuse to misroute tenant headers under concurrency.

sam-oncall: can we repro locally by hammering with parallel streams and duplicated tenant header? I can run a small load test against eu1.

karen-support: customer says their SDK retries quickly (burst of ~8 requests concurrently) — might be triggering it. also they have a custom proxy injecting X-Tenant-ID twice.

jeff-infra: aha. I grep logs and see occurrences of header: `x-tenant-id: acme-42, acme-42` (duplicate). Envoy route matching does prefix lookup and we had a recent change where the LB started collapsing duplicate headers into a single comma list. under high concurrency that interacts poorly with our tenant routing filter -> sometimes matches wrong tenant, forwarding to auth backend which rejects and edge returns 502.

maria-sre: mitigation options: (1) quick fix: strip duplicate tenant header at edge filter (2) short rollback of heartbeat change to earlier timing (3) add per-connection header sanitization in frontdoor to dedupe. Which do we want now?

sam-oncall: prioritize minimal blast radius -> push header-strip at edge (hotfix) and add a temporary rate-limit on auth-proxy keepalive reuse. I'll prepare a patch for frontdoor filter (small Lua hook) and a dynconfig change for auth-proxy pool.

infra-bot: deploy queued: frontdoor/edge-header-filter v2026.03.18-ht1 -> canary to 10% in eu1 in 60s.

karen-support: customer on call confirmed we can try canary. they will try again after canary warms.

jeff-infra: canary shows drop in 502 rate for acme-42 requests. stack traces show fewer RST_STREAMs and no duplicate header lists.

maria-sre: pushing full roll now, and we'll keep auth-heartbeat at current setting. long term: we'll add a validation rule in SDK docs + server-side dedupe to avoid relying on client behavior. also ticketing: BUG-3141 for routing mismatch + RFC for header normalization.

sam-oncall: postmortem notes: root cause = header duplication + recent LB header-collapsing change + auth-proxy keepalive timing change. mitigation = strip dup headers at edge + dynconfig to reduce connection reuse between auth-proxy and frontdoor. action items assigned. :white_check_mark:

karen-support: customer confirmed degraded traffic now back to normal and will close their escalation after 24h of monitoring. thanks everyone!
